title: Eskişehir’de İklim Adaleti Forumu: “İklim adaleti mücadelesi sınıfsal temelde ele alınmalı”
content:
Eskişehir Ekoloji Derneği tarafından Taşbaşı Kültür Merkezi’nde İklim Adaleti Forumu düzenlendi. İklim krizinin sınıfsal boyutunun, emisyon ticaret sisteminin, madencilik faaliyetlerinin ve uluslararası iklim politikalarının ele alındığı forumda, ekoloji mücadelesinin emek ve yaşam hakkı mücadelesiyle birleştirilmesi gerektiği vurgulandı.

Forumda avukat Mert Yedek ve avukat Onat Öncü’nün yanı sıra Eskişehir-Bilecik Tabip Odası Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Murat Erol, TMMOB Makina Mühendisleri Odası Eskişehir Şubesi adına Mustafa Haydar Tiftikçi, İYİP Odunpazarı İlçe Başkanı Gürol Yer, Çiftçi-Sen Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Hasan Cengiz Yazar, Emek Partisi Eskişehir İl Örgütü adına Şevval Duran, ziraat yüksek mühendisi Zevaiddin Özcan, Tüm Emeklilerin Sendikası Eskişehir Şubesi Yürütme Kurulu Üyesi Alim Yıldızkan, Eskişehir Gıda Topluluğundan Emin İrfan Akkaya, Türkiye Ormancılar Derneği Eskişehir Temsilcisi Deniz Hakan Durmuş, Eskişehir Barosu Kent ve Çevre Komisyonu Başkanı Ecir Ayaş ve akademisyen Ozan Devrim Yay söz aldı.

Avukat Mert Yedek, iklim krizinin sonuçlarının toplumun bütün kesimlerini aynı biçimde etkilemediğine dikkat çekerek iklim adaleti mücadelesinin sınıfsal bir perspektifle ele alınması gerektiğini söyledi. Aşırı yağışlar, sel ve taşkınlar gibi iklim krizinin sonuçlarından en fazla emekçilerin ve yoksulların etkilendiğini belirten Yedek, sermaye sahiplerinin ise sahip oldukları ekonomik olanaklarla kendilerini bu sonuçlardan kısmen koruyabildiğini ifade etti.

Yedek, “Bir avuç, yüzde 1’e tekabül edecek sermayedarlar bir şekilde buradan kendi birikimleri ve servet birikimleriyle birlikte kendilerine sürdürülebilir bir yaşamı var edebiliyorlar. Ama adalet kısmı burada açığa çıkıyor” sözleriyle iklim krizinin yarattığı eşitsizliğe dikkat çekti. Krizin sorumluluğunun ve sonuçlarının toplumun farklı kesimleri arasında eşit dağılmadığını vurgulayan Yedek, iklim adaleti tartışmasının yalnızca çevresel etkilerle sınırlı tutulamayacağını belirtti.

İklim krizi karşısında bireysel tüketim alışkanlıklarının değiştirilmesinin çözüm olarak sunulmasını da eleştiren Yedek, su tüketimini azaltmak, toplu taşıma kullanmak ve bireysel karbon ayak izini düşürmek gibi önerilerin büyük şirketlerin ve üretim faaliyetlerinin sorumluluğunu geri plana ittiğini söyledi. Bireysel önlemlerin öneminin, üretim ilişkileri ve sermayenin doğa üzerindeki etkisi tartışılmadan ele alınamayacağını belirten Yedek, iklim krizinin yapısal nedenlerine odaklanılması gerektiğini ifade etti.

Yeşil dönüşüm ve net sıfır emisyon hedefleri kapsamında gündeme getirilen emisyon ticaret sistemini de değerlendiren Yedek, karbon salımının alınıp satılabilen ekonomik bir değere dönüştürülmesine karşı çıktı. Karbon salımının piyasa mekanizmaları üzerinden düzenlenmesinin iklim krizini ortadan kaldırmaya yetmeyeceğini belirten Yedek, “Karbon devredilebilir, ücretlendirilebilir, ekonomik bir değer verilebilir ve tahsis edilebilen bir meta hâline getirildi” dedi.

Yedek, emisyonların ticarete konu edilmesinin iklim krizinin çözümünü piyasanın işleyişine bağladığını belirterek, “Bizim tartıştığımız bu makro iklim krizi dediğimiz ve herkesin yakıcı bir şekilde hissettiği durumu önleyebilmesi ne yazık ki mümkün değil” ifadelerini kullandı. İklim politikalarının şirketlerin kârlarını ve piyasa ilişkilerini korumak yerine emisyonların azaltılmasını ve ekolojik yıkımın önlenmesini esas alması gerektiğini vurguladı.

Yedek, yeşil dönüşüm politikalarının yalnızca yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları üzerinden değerlendirilmesine karşı çıkarak bu dönüşüm için gerekli görülen madenlerin hangi amaçlarla kullanıldığının da sorgulanması gerektiğini söyledi. Nadir toprak elementlerinin yalnızca enerji teknolojilerinde değil, savunma sanayisi ve silah teknolojilerinde de kullanıldığına dikkat çeken Yedek, bu kaynaklar üzerindeki rekabetin uluslararası güç mücadeleleriyle bağlantısına işaret etti.

Türkiye’de madencilik faaliyetleri ve acele kamulaştırma kararlarının yerel halkın yaşamı üzerindeki etkilerine değinen Yedek, Eskişehir’de nadir toprak elementlerinin çıkarılmasına yönelik girişimlerin de bölge halkının üretimini ve geleceğini doğrudan ilgilendirdiğini belirtti. Yıllardır işledikleri topraklardan geçimini sağlayan köylülerin, yaşamlarını etkileyecek kararların alınmasında yeterince söz sahibi olmadığını ifade etti.

Üreticilerin yaptıkları harcamalar, ektikleri ürünler ve gelecek dönem için kurdukları ekonomik planların bu süreçlerde belirsizliğe sürüklendiğini belirten …

author: Marcus Baram
title: Aging Coal Plants Turn Into a Midterm Fight Over Energy Costs
content:
Climate and energy battles are running through campaigns in Michigan, Colorado, Indiana, and beyond.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Craig Unit 1, a coal-fired power plant distinguished by tall exhaust smokestacks that rise above a rolling landscape in northwestern Colorado, was scheduled to close for good at the end of 2025 amid pressure from environmental advocates, public interest groups and state officials.

But on Dec. 30, Energy Secretary Chris Wright ordered it to keep burning coal. The unit had suffered a mechanical failure 11 days earlier and was not even running. Wright has since renewed the order three times — most recently on Sept. 25, extending the plant’s life through Christmas Day, a full year past its retirement date.

Its operator, Tri-State Generation and Transmission, is a nonprofit rural cooperative, and in January it joined co-owner Platte River Power Authority, a public power agency, in arguing that Wright’s orders violate the Constitution and federal law — a fight that has since reached a federal appeals court in Washington, D.C. A co-op and a municipal utility suing the executive branch for the right to close their own coal plant was not what Congress had in mind in 1935, when it wrote the emergency provision that the Energy Department is now leaning on.

Data centers and gas pump prices have dominated the energy story in this midterm cycle — polls show broad opposition to the artificial intelligence build-out over utility bills and grid strain. But with just weeks until Election Day, a second tier of climate and energy battles is running through campaigns in Michigan, Colorado, Indiana and beyond: forced coal plant extensions, canceled plans for offshore wind farms, repealed clean energy tax credits, drought, state preemption of local climate rules and a drumbeat of federal rollbacks. None of these issues poll as high as affordability. But all of them, say the people trying to turn them into votes, are essential to the affordability debate.

Starting in May 2025, the Energy Department invoked Section 202(c) of the Federal Power Act to order Consumers Energy’s J.H. Campbell plant in West Olive, Michigan, to stay online past its planned retirement, then renewed the order five more times.

Similar mandates followed for Craig and for the Schahfer and Culley plants in Indiana, each justified by grid reliability. On Sept. 11, a unanimous D.C. Circuit panel, in an opinion written by Judge Cornelia Pillard, ruled that the first two Campbell orders were illegal — no genuine emergency existed to justify overriding Michigan’s regulators.

Ari Peskoe, director of the Electricity Law Initiative at Harvard Law School, said the provision had been dormant for decades after some early wartime use. “Over the past 20 to 30 years it’s really been used almost exclusively for weather-related events,” he said, “and it only lasts a few days.”

Nothing like Wright’s coal orders had been tried. “In every prior instance there’s been some entity, whether a utility, a grid operator or a state regulator, that’s asked for these orders. Here it’s [the Department of Energy] acting on its own,” he said. “No one had asked for it. And to the contrary, some had said, ’Please don’t do this.’”

The administration has until roughly the end of October to decide whether to appeal. If it lets the ruling stand, Peskoe said, “I think the other orders for the other plants will fall pretty quickly.”

Utility giant Consumers Energy put the net cost of running Campbell from May 23, 2025, through June 30 of this year at $295 million, after wholesale market revenue. Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel’s office has cited that figure, against nearly $600 million in savings the retirement was supposed to deliver. In August, federal regulators let Consumers Energy spread the costs across the grid’s north and central regions — from North Dakota to Indiana. That means Wisconsin ratepayers, whose share one estimate puts at $117 million, could wind up paying for a Michigan coal plant. The recent appeals court decision overturning the Energy Department’s order could spare taxpayers those costs.

Brian Wheeler, spokesperson for Consumers Energy, said the utility would work to ensure “everyone who benefits from power from the Campbell plant across the Midwest pays their fair share.” Nessel, who has challenged all six orders, said …

author: groundxero
title: এসআরএফটিআই-তে শিক্ষার্থী বরখাস্ত, উপাচার্যের ইস্তফার দাবিতে চলছে ধর্না মঞ্চ, পরিস্থিতি জটিল
content:
“… আমরা চেয়ারম্যান ও মন্ত্রকের হস্তক্ষেপ দাবি করেই যাব ও উপাচার্য ইস্তফা না দেওয়া পর্যন্ত আন্দোলন চলবে,” বললেন বরখাস্ত হওয়া এসআরএফটিআই-এর এক শিক্ষার্থী।


 


সুদর্শনা চক্রবর্তীর

 প্রতিবেদন


 


গত ২৭ সেপ্টেম্বর থেকে কলকাতার সত্যজিৎ রায় ফিল্ম অ্যান্ড টেলিভিশন ইনস্টিটিউট-এ পরপর দু’বার বিজেপি-আরএসএস আশ্রিত হিন্দুত্ববাদী দুষ্কৃতিদের আক্রমণ এবং শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠানের উপাচার্যের কার্যৎ শিক্ষার্থী-বিরোধী মনোভাব ও পদক্ষেপের জন্য শিক্ষার্থীরা ক্লাস বয়কট ও শান্তিপূর্ণ অবস্থান-ধর্ণার পথ বেছে নেওয়ায় প্রতিষ্ঠানের পঠন-পাঠনে অচলাবস্থা তৈরি হয়েছে।


 


এরই মাঝে গত ১৫ অক্টোবর ছ’জন পড়ুয়াকে বরখাস্তের চিঠি পাঠানো হয়েছে। যে চিঠিতে বরখাস্তের কারণ ও সময়সীমা কিছুই সঠিকভাবে উল্লিখিত নয়। এই বরখাস্তের চিঠির বিষয়ে পড়ুয়ারা ইতিমধ্যেই আইনি ব্যবস্থা নেওয়ার দিকে এগিয়েছে। আচমকাই ১৫ অক্টোবর এই বরখাস্তের চিঠি পাওয়ার পর ১৬ অক্টোবর শিক্ষার্থীরা জরুরি ভিত্তিতে একটি সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনের ডাক দিন। তাঁরা প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভেতরে ধর্ণা মঞ্চের সামনে এই সাংবাদিক সম্মেলন করতে চাইলেও কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশে দীর্ঘ সময় টালবাহানার পর সাংবাদিকদের প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভেতরে ঢোকার অনুমতি দেওয়া হয় না। শেষ পর্যন্ত বন্ধ মূল ফটকের ভেতর থেকেই বাইরে দাঁড়ানো সাংবাদিকদের সঙ্গে সাংবাদিক সম্মেলন করেন শিক্ষার্থীরা।


 


এই সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে অংশ নেওয়া শিক্ষার্থীরা বারেবারেই যে বিষয়টির উপর জোর দিচ্ছিলেন তা হল – উপাচার্য নিজের বিবৃতি, কাজকর্ম, শিক্ষার্থীদের প্রতি নির্দেশের মধ্যে দিয়ে বারেবারেই যা প্রমাণ করার চেষ্টা করছেন তা হল, প্রতিষ্ঠানে সব কিছু স্বাভাবিক আছে এবং শান্তিপূর্ণ প্রতিবাদরত শিক্ষার্থীদের প্রতিবাদ তুলে নিয়ে ক্লাসে ফেরার জন্য চাপ দেওয়া হচ্ছে। এবং স্টুডেন্টস ইউনিয়ন-এর হাতে গোনা কয়েক জন শিক্ষার্থীই এই ক্লাস বয়কট ও অবস্থান বিক্ষোভে মদত দিচ্ছেন, বাকিরা সকলেই ক্লাস চালু করার পক্ষে। ১৫ অক্টোবর, সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে অংশ নেওয়া পড়ুয়ারা এই বিষয়ে স্পষ্টতই জানান একেবারেই নতুন ও চলতি ব্যাচের সিনিয়র পড়ুয়ারা, এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের সমস্ত ছাত্রছাত্রী একজোটভাবে এই প্রতিবাদে শামিল, তা আদপেই বরখাস্তের নোটিস পাঠানো পাঁচ-ছ’জন শিক্ষার্থী বা শুধুই স্টুডেন্টস ইউনিয়ন-এর বিষয় নয়।


 


বরখাস্তের বিষয়টির পাশে এদিন শিক্ষার্থীরা সরাসরি অভিযোগ আনেন সিকিওরিটি অফিসার পি কে, মুন্সি-র বিরূদ্ধে। উপাচার্যের পাশাপাশি মূলত তিনিই শিক্ষার্থীর বিরূদ্ধে নানাবিধ পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া, তাঁদের নানাভাবে হেনস্থা করছেন বলে অভিযোগ করেন তাঁরা। অন্যদিকে উপাচার্য বা অন্য কোনো কর্মীদের সঙ্গে কোনোরকম দুর্ব্যবহারের অভিযোগ সর্বৈব মিথ্যা বলেও জানান তাঁরা। এই পি কে মুন্সির বিরূদ্ধে প্রতিষ্ঠানের একজন অত্যন্ত বরিষ্ঠ মহিলা কর্মী, যিনি ১৯৯৫ থেকে কর্মরত ও শিক্ষার্থীদের প্রতি সমমনোভাবাপন্ন তিনি হেনস্থার অভিযোগ আনলেও কোনো রকম পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া হয়নি বলেও সেই অভিযোগপত্র সহ শিক্ষার্থীরা জানান।


 


তারেক, সুদীপ, অ্যারন, জয়দীপ, আকাঙ্খা, ব্লসম (স্টুডেন্টস ইউনিয়ন-এর সভাপতি) বক্তব্য রাখেন।


 


“আমরা সারা ভারতের বিভিন্ন প্রান্ত থেকে অনেক ফিল্ম স্কুলে পড়ার সুযোগ ছেড়ে এখানে পড়তে আসি। অথচ আমাদের হস্টেলের সুবিধা প্রথম থেকেই দেওয়া হয় না। আর আমরা গত কয়েক সপ্তাহ ধরে এখানে যা দেখছি তাতে আমাদের নিরাপত্তা নিয়ে আমরা চিন্তিত। একজন মুসলিম হিসাবেও এখানে উপাচার্য ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের আচরণে আমি প্রান্তিক বোধ করছি,”

 বলেন তারেক।


 


২৭ সেপ্টেম্বর ও ৪ অক্টোবরের আক্রমণের পরেও প্রতিষ্ঠানের প্রশাসনিক স্তর থেকে শিক্ষার্থীদের সঙ্গে কোনো রকম যোগাযোগ করা হয়নি। বাইরের যে ফ্যাসিবাদী শক্তির আক্রমণ সারা দেশ জুড়ে দেখা যাচ্ছে, তারই প্রতিফলন যেন প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভেতরেও দেখা যাচ্ছে বলে শিক্ষার্থীরা মন্তব্য করেন। এই আক্রমণের বিরূদ্ধে যাঁরাই উপাচার্যকে দায় স্বীকার করতে বলেছেন তাঁদেরই টার্গেট করা হচ্ছে। যাঁরা ৪ অক্টোবরের পর উপাচার্যকে সাময়িক ঘেরাও ও প্রতিবাদে অংশ নেন, তাঁরা বাদেও যাঁরা সেদিন ছিলেন না বা এমনকি কলকাতার বাইরে ছিলেন তাঁদেরও শো-কজ চিঠি পাঠানো হয়েছে। নিয়মশৃঙ্খলা ভঙ্গের অভিযোগ আনা হচ্ছে শিক্ষার্থীদের বিরূদ্ধে, যেখানে তাঁদের নিরাপত্তার দায় প্রতিষ্ঠান নিচ্ছে না। কেবলই তাঁদের নানা রকম ভয় দেখিয়ে ও তাঁদের উপর চাপ সৃষ্টি করে ক্লাস শুরু করতে বলা হচ্ছে – যার চরম উদাহরণ কোনো রকম আগাম ইঙ্গিত ছাড়াই শিক্ষার্থীদের বরখাস্তের নোটিস পাঠানো। উপস্থিত শিক্ষার্থীরা সকলেই জানান যে নব নিযুক্ত উপাচার্য এতদিন পর্যন্ত শিক্ষার্থীদের করা সমস্ত অভিযোগের প্রতিই কোনো রকম প্রতিক্রিয়া না জানানোয় এবং তাঁর পুরোপুরি ফ্যাসিবাদীসুলভ শিক্ষার্থী বিরোধী আচরণের জন্য শিক্ষার্থীরা একজোট ও একমত হয়ে তাঁর ইস্তফার দাবিতেই অনড় থাকছেন।


 


জয়দীপ যিনি দুষ্কৃতিদের আক্রমে আহত হয়েছিলেন ও এখনো যাঁর একটি অস্ত্রোপচার বাকি, তিনি জানান উপাচার্যের সঙ্গে দেখা করতে চেয়েও তিনি পারেননি। উপাচার্য কোনো অবস্থাতেই আন্দোলনরত ও দাবিপত্র জমা দেওয়া শিক্ষার্থী বা প্রতিনিধিদের সঙ্গে দেখা করতে রাজি হননি। এমতাবস্থায় পড়ুয়াদের দাবি – “

সব কিছু স্বাভাবিক এমনটা ভান করা অবিলম্বে বন্ধ করতে হবে এবং সংবাদমাধ্যম, সংশ্লিষ্ট মন্ত্রক সর্বত্র আসল ছবিটি, পড়ুয়াদের নিরাপত্তাহীনতার বিষয়টি তুলে ধরতে হবে।”


 


ধর্ম, বর্ণ, লিঙ্গ পরিচিতি নিয়ে সদ্য আসা উপাচার্য সন্তোষ আজমের চূড়ান্ত বৈষম্য করছেন বলেও …

author: Redazione_web
title: Quando il Messico incontra la Sicilia
content:
Domenica 27 settembre, nella Piazza del Villaggio di Locogrande, a Misiliscemi, c’è stato un evento che è stato un toccasana al cuore e alla testa. Un’iniziativa pubblica promossa da una rete di realtà del territorio ha trasformato una piccola piazza di provincia nel punto d’incontro tra la nostra terra e le lotte di tutto il mondo.


La mattinata si è aperta nel modo più semplice e vivo possibile: un laboratorio artistico e creativo collettivo, aperto a tutti e tutte. Già dalle dieci del mattino la piazza si è popolata di colori, pennarelli e grandi cartelli da riempire insieme. È stato uno spazio informale e leggero, ma allo stesso tempo profondamente radicato nei nostri problemi reali. Tra una scritta e una risata, lavoratori, residenti, attivisti e curiosi si sono ritrovati fianco a fianco. E parlando dei cartelli che stavamo preparando sull’acqua, sul diritto alla vita, contro la base militare e gli F-35 a Trapani-Birgi, sono nate riflessioni spontanee, genuine, fatte di sguardi e condivisione. In quel fare manuale e spensierato c’era già l’alternativa: riprendersi i propri spazi pubblici partendo dalla cura e dallo stare insieme senza deleghe.


Da quel clima di laboratorio, la mattinata è sfociata con naturalezza nel momento assembleare, iniziato verso l’una. Ed è lì che il respiro della giornata si è allargato in modo straordinario, ascoltando direttamente i rappresentanti della delegazione internazionale arrivata dal Messico. A prendere la parola per prima è stata la rappresentante del Centro per i Diritti Umani Frayba, portando con sé il peso e la lucidità di chi opera quotidianamente nel Chiapas, a fianco delle comunità oppresse. Ascoltarla è stato un pugno nello stomaco e insieme una spinta immensa: ci ha raccontato la violenza feroce e sistematica subita da chi difende i diritti umani, la terra e la vita contro i grandi interessi delle multinazionali e dei governi, ricordandoci cosa significhi fare i conti con i vicini di casa desaparecidos e con una militarizzazione che calpesta ogni forma di dignità umana.


Subito dopo, l’intervento dei delegati del Congresso Nazionale Indigeno (CNI) ha allargato ulteriormente lo sguardo, portando la voce viva dei popoli originari che resistono contro l’espropriazione dei territori e la devastazione ambientale. Hanno raccontato di come le comunità continuino a organizzarsi dal basso proponendo invece che imponendo, raccogliendo la forza radicale dello zapatismo per praticare l’autogoverno e difendere la propria terra rifiutando la logica cinica del profitto. Certo, chi vive lì affronta dinamiche e tragedie di una gravità per noi quasi inimmaginabile, eppure ascoltandoli parlare in quella piazza di Misiliscemi, la sensazione più nitida è stata un’altra, cioè che tutto il mondo è intrinsecamente legato.


Perché mentre ascoltavi le loro storie, capivi perfettamente che la mano che devasta i territori e calpesta i diritti laggiù è la stessa identica mano che in provincia di Trapani impone le basi militari, investe i nostri risparmi nel campo di addestramento per i piloti degli F-35 e condanna la nostra terra alla sete, all’abbandono e all’emigrazione giovanile. Il sistema economico, statale e militare che ci governa è totalizzante e globale, non fa sconti a nessuno e sfrutta le periferie del mondo per i propri profitti.


Ma la lezione più grande di quell’assemblea non è stata la constatazione amara di quanto questo sistema sia cinico: la vera forza è stata scoprire che la resistenza è altrettanto globale. In quella piazza si è toccato con mano cosa significhi l’internazionalismo: non una parola vuota da convegno, ma sguardi, parole condivise, mani che si stringono e la consapevolezza che i nostri problemi non sono affatto isolati. La nostra piccola vertenza locale contro la base di Birgi prende forza e respiro quando si collega alle lotte di chi, in ogni angolo del pianeta, rifiuta di essere merce o scarto.


La convergenza tra i popoli ci ha ricordato che la vera sicurezza non si costruisce con gli aerei d’attacco o con i confini armati, ma curando la terra, difendendo l’acqua e stringendo legami autentici di solidarietà. La strada per cambiare le cose è lunga, irta e difficile, come sappiamo bene qui in Sicilia, ma l’incontro a Locogrande ci ha lasciato una certezza luminosa: non siamo soli. E sapere di camminare insieme a chi, da lontano, lotta con la stessa nostra dignità, ti dà una spinta formidabile per continuare a fare la tua parte, qui, nel nostro piccolo …

author: Administrador
title: Preparativos Zapatistas para el Encuentro Abrazo con familias Buscadoras. Parte I: Jóvenes Teatristas
content:
Música: Caifanes, «Antes de que nos olviden» Imágenes: Terci@s Compas Zapatistas

Estaba yo como quien dice, así nomás, acaso estoy pensando nada. Pero tenía yo mi mejor cara del más caifán de los caifanes, el más banda y chido de la banda y de los chidos. Así estoy pues y ahí nomás lo miro que viene caminando el Riko, que no así se llama mero de bautizo, sino que así se puso porque, dice, es el más chulo del barrio, de la broza, de la plebe, y que todas las morras pues suspiran por él merengues. Riko o “Rikolin” se autodenomina, dice que el otro día pelearon por él dos chavas, pero yo lo sé que sí pelearon, pero no por él, sino porque la de la miscelánea no le dio cabal el cambio a la otra. Pero el Riko Rickolin jura y perjura que fue por el privilegio de sus encantos. Bueno, de ahí que llega y me dice: “¿Qué pues mi capi? ¿andas de incónito?”. “Incógnito”, se dice “incógnito”, le corrijo. “Eso”, dice el Riko, y sigue “¿y qué jais de la wuirinais”. El Riko cree que habla con caló de barrio, pero ni mais palomas naranjas podridas. “Pos aquí pichiluqueando”, le respondo para seguirle la corriente. El Riko ve que no hay nadie más y abandona la pose ligadora número 69 de su catálogo, y me pregunta “¿y que piensas de eso?”. “¿Cuál eso?” “Pos eso” “No sé qué es eso”. “Pos lo que se anda rumoreando por ahí, el chisme pues. O como dicen las jóvenas zapatudas: “la información compartida”. O sea que mismo chisme, pero más elegante.” “No sé qué cosa se anda rumorando”. “Pos eso, que un tokin” “¿Cuál tokín?” “Oh pues, tokín dícese de cuando hay una tocada, unas rolas, un concierto pues. O sea que no es un tokín de prexta pá la orquexta, sino tokin musical”. “Ah, ya. No, no sé nada”, digo fingiendo desinterés, porque sé que eso provoca más al Riko. El Riko se sienta en la banqueta y me susurra: “un concierto, no mero sé dónde ni cuándo, pero un concierto. Quesque los meros Caifanes, y que mi novia la Ely Guerra, y que la Vivir Quintana, y que los Contingentes Jaraneros, y que el Kevin Kaarl, y que el Meme del Real. Juntos, pero no revueltos.

O sea que el todo y las partes, como quien dice.”

“Y ¿dónde, cuándo, cómo, por qué?”, lo apremio.

“A saber”, dice el Riko, encendiendo lo que creo es un cigarrillo, “creo que no lo dicen luego porque tienen miedo de que les caiga la justicia”.

“¿Por qué les caería la justicia? ¿Para qué es pues el concierto?” “Pos para el encuentro-abrazo con las familias buscadoras” “¿Y eso que tiene de malo? ¿Por qué les va a caer la tira?” “Okela, pos por el Meme, ¿no sabes que ya prohibieron los memes? Y pos luego la tira no muy le sabe a nada, y creo que se levantan a todos… y todas, no olvidar la paridad de género. Pa no fallarle, dicen”. “Ah, pos está cabreras”, digo ya entrando en ambiente. “Pero si no se sabe cuándo y dónde, ¿cómo le va a hacer la banda para caerle’”, pregunto.

“Ni idea”, dice el Riko, “pero creo no tarda, porque si no, pues de balde una tocada si nadie sabe dónde y cuándo.

Pero el asunto, mi estimado capitán balín, es que nadie cobra, o sea ni los que le hacen de musiqueros, ni quienes organizan, ni quienes producen, ni quienes ponen el local. Sacan el gasto, nada de ganancia propia, todo para el encuentro. Por solidaridad de la buena. Es más, ni yo les voy a cobrar. Voy a ir a apersonarme gratis. Para darle como quien dice brillo y realce al evento. Todo el varo es para el encuentro con buscadoras. Todo cabal, todo planchado.”

“Nah, no te creo”, le dije para ver si soltaba algo más.

El Riko se pone de pie y sentencia:

“Ése es el problema, que ya nadie cree en nada. No creen en la solidaridad desinteresada, en la bondad, en la nobleza, en la humanidad … ni en la buena música. Porque eso, la solidaridad, debe ser siempre una fiesta. Y una fiesta sin música es como tener el cigarro, pero no el encendedor. ¿Cómo te prendes, pues?”.

Se va el Riko rumbo al puesto de tamales. La ñora le dice “¿Qué pasó ése mi Riko? ¿Va a querer de chivo los tamales?” y sonríe con picardía. El Riko aguanta el golpe y pide dos champurrados.

author: Shan Kenshin Ecaldre
title: Palawan farmers remain landless
content:
FILE PHOTO: Women farmers in Lupang Ramos (Photo by Carlo Manalansan / Bulatlat)

CORON, Palawan — For more than a decade, 38 families of farmers in Coron, Palawan faced possible eviction from a disputed property awarded to beneficiaries whom peasant groups stressed are not the actual tillers.

The Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas (KMP) and Katipunan ng Samahan ng mga Magbubukid sa Timog Katagalugan (KASAMA-TK) said that the decades-long dispute over 887.76 hectares of agricultural land in Barangay Decalachao exposes the failure of agrarian reform programs.

The groups referred to the unresolved dispute involving the Philippine Agri-Business Center Corporation (PACECO) and the former Yulo King Ranch (YKR) where farmers organized under Alyansa ng Magsasaka at Mamamayan sa Yulo King Ranch (ALMMA-YKR) remain excluded from portions of the land they cultivate.

“From PD 27 to CARP, farmers have been promised land reform for decades, yet actual tillers remain excluded from the land they cultivate,” said Danilo Ramos, KMP chairperson, referring to Presidential Decree 27 and the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program.

According to KASAMA-TK, farmers began clearing and cultivating portions of the property in November 2009. The dispute affects 38 families or more than 200 people.

In 2014, 361 individuals were given Certificates of Land Ownership Award (CLOAs) covering portions of the property. However, the group said that most of the beneficiaries were not the actual tillers occupying the land.

Some actual tillers were excluded from the awards while nine farmers received CLOAs containing technical descriptions that did not match the land they occupied. KASAMA-TK also reported that some beneficiaries who did not cultivate the property began selling their awarded land in 2016.

The farmers brought their complaints to the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) in 2020 and filed a petition for disqualification in 2021, seeking the cancellation of awards issued to allegedly unqualified beneficiaries.

The petition remains unresolved, according to a case briefer provided by the groups despite a 2022 directive for the local DAR office to report on the complaints.

Meanwhile, the farmers faced possible eviction and fabricated criminal charges for asserting their rights to the land.

For KMP and KASAMA-TK, the situation shows how agrarian reform can fail its intended beneficiaries when land distribution prioritizes the issuance of titles over the rights of those who cultivate the land.

The conflict is rooted in the Marcos Sr. administration’s declaration of 40,000 hectares in Coron and Busuanga as the Busuanga Pasture Reserve in 1975 through Proclamation No. 1387.

The area was operated by Yulo King Ranch, owned by Marcos associate Luis Yulo. PACECO later claimed 887.76 hectares within the former ranch area.

Although the disputed property was placed under the CARP’s coverage in 1993 and a Notice of Coverage was issued, farmers alleged that the DAR office in Coron withheld the notice.

The subsequent distribution of land titles, which reportedly excluded actual tillers, has left the farmers contesting awards that they say failed to recognize their longstanding cultivation of the property.

Renato Batocabe of KASAMA-TK said the dispute reflects the failure of existing agrarian reform measures to resolve the fundamental problem of landlessness.

“PD 27 and CARP have failed to resolve the fundamental problem of landlessness. The farmers of Yulo King Ranch deserve justice, not more broken promises,” Batocabe said.

He said that distributing land titles to individuals who do not cultivate the land, while excluding the farmers who do, does not constitute genuine agrarian reform.

The groups’ criticism centers on the gap between the government’s land distribution policies and the conditions faced by landless farmers. Despite decades of agrarian reform initiatives, the PACECO dispute remains unresolved, leaving farming families uncertain about their access to the land they till.

KASAMA-TK called on the DAR to immediately resolve the pending petition, review the CLOAs issued to allegedly unqualified beneficiaries, and cancel awards found to have been improperly issued through due process.

It also demanded a relocation survey to establish the boundaries of the land cultivated by qualified farmers and ensure that awards correspond to the areas they actually till.

author: Aizel Tugalon
title: Progressive solons file bill, resolutions on academic freedom
content:
Photo by John Andrei Rarang, The Staple

Progressive lawmakers under the Makabayan bloc filed House Bill No. 11678, or the Academic Freedom Act on Monday, October 12, a bill seeking to defend academic freedom.

The bill came after recent attacks on academic freedom, such as the suspension of four University of Santo Tomas (UST) student activists for protesting against a campus exhibit by the Philippine Air Force (PAF) and the red-tagging of students and faculty members of the University of the Philippines Rural High School (UPRHS).

In her statement, Kabataan Partylist Rep. Renee Co condemned attempts to silence students who have been at the forefront of the fight for social justice and against corruption, especially since the onset of the flood control scandal.

“Discipline offices and military propaganda must not be used to silence students who are simply asking questions about and wanting to stop state abuse,” the statement read.

The bill, which adopts the 2024 UN Draft Principles for Implementing the Right to Academic Freedom and the 2026 Special Rapporteur Report on Youth Activism, seeks to impose imprisonment and fines on violations of academic freedom, such as militarization of campuses, infiltrating student organizations, filing disciplinary punishments against students who engage in peaceful political dissent, and enacting threats and violence against members of the academic community,

Furthermore, the three lawmakers also filed House Resolution No. 1541condemning the red-tagging perpetrated by former National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) spokespersons Lorraine Badoy and Antonio Parlade and other actors related to NTF-ELCAC against students and faculty members of UPRHS and the UP Los Baños (UPLB) College of Arts and Sciences (CAS) Department of Humanities.

These attacks came after UPRHS’ commemoration of the UP Day of Remembrance during the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law on September 21.

Read: Badoy red tags UP Rural High School teacher, community

The resolution also cited the red-tagging of a Facebook page misusing the name of UPLB Perspective against campus journalists, student leaders, and administrative officials of UPLB.

Read: UPLB decries systematic red-tagging of constituents

Additionally, the Makabayan bloc filed House Resolution No. 1540, which condemns the profiling, surveillance, and intimidation of officers of the Philippine National Police (PNP) against members of the Alliance of Concerned Teachers (ACT)-Region V Union in Camarines Sur.

In line with the Supreme Court’s ruling on red-tagging as a threat to life, liberty, and security, the resolutions call for an investigation of the said cases and the crafting of legislative measures to defend students’ rights and academic freedom. (AMU, RVO)

title: Indigenous Just Transition in The Arctic
content:
This is going to be a collaborative event between Ungeirr Umkveraasenaar, or the Icelandic Young Environmentalists, and the Indigenous Environmental Network. Maybe we can go around and you guys can give a little introduction about yourselves. Sure.

Huang’a a’ka, pang’a’anang naka pang’a’u yu, huang’a a’taka, a’anatirma, naka kirstinuga pás, huang’a sivunga rumi. I come from St. Lawrence Island. I’ve been with IEN since 2021, and I work on organizing against climate geoengineering.

Kweyanaipaplusi maunga, huang’a a’akaluk, ungelaksirmiu runga, angayukang maktaklu Charlie. I a’anukwa’apu’a makigaklu anaktiyuk asii, janililu Charlie, chinirmiu, ungelaksirmiu. Thank you everyone for welcoming us here today.

I’m Adrienne A’akaluk Blatchford. I’m from Unalakleet, Alaska, which is up on the Northwest Coast in the passageway to the Arctic. We’re right on the coast of the Bering Sea in the heart of the Norton Sound.

And I work with Indigenous Environmental Network as a geoengineering outreach organizer with a focus on Alaska and the Arctic. Hello, thank you for having us as the host.

My name is Thomas Joseph. I’m a Hoopa Valley tribal member from the Six Rivers National Forest in Northern California. I am also Shoshone Paiute from the Sierra Nevadas. Paiute is what we call it, the land of flowing water.

I’m down there by Yosemite and the Half Dome area. I am here with the Indigenous Environmental Network as their carbon pricing educator. And again, thanks for having us.

Yá’át’ééh. My name is Talia Boyd. Older women from my community who love to have the time of their lives shared with me.

Greetings, everyone. My name is Talia Boyd. I’m the mining organizer for IEN.

I’m based in New Mexico, originally from Arizona, and I hail from the Navajo Nation in the Southwest. And I’m very honored to be here with y’all and share this space and time. Thank you.

Awesome. And a little bit about me for any of you who don’t know me. My name is Isla.

I’m originally from Wales and I’ve been living here in Iceland for over five years and I’m the education representative for the Icelandic Young Environmentalists. So how about we just go straight into things and you guys can give us a little bit of an oral presentation about your work and everything that you do and then we’ll get started with the panel Q&A afterwards. Sounds good.

Thank you. So I want to kind of do a little bit of an introduction on who is the Indigenous Environmental Network. Over 30 years ago the United States, we’re kind of seeing that return back to that, was having a really hard time addressing the mining operations of uranium in the southwest and the Indigenous people came together as they were the ones that were being directly affected by these mining operations that was being used for the production of uranium for the purpose of war.

And so the Indigenous peoples from that region rallied together to try to protect their communities against the high rates of cancers and other issues that was plaguing their communities to no avail. The state governments wouldn’t listen to them. The national governments wouldn’t listen to them and so they seen that it was in their best interest to take this fight to the international space of the United Nations and that’s when the Indigenous Environmental Network was formed with the purpose and intent of taking the struggles of the mining and the struggles of the health impacts of mining to a global positioning.

The Indigenous Environmental Network has been active in the United Nations space since then and in various different causes pertaining to the Paris Climate Agreement, water issues, mining issues, also very active in the Convention on Biological Diversity and we continue to play a role of Indigenous networks across Turtle Island. So we come from impacted communities of Indigenous peoples. Frontline community is another term that’s often used from across Turtle Island of communities that are faced with deforestation, faced with dams, faced with any type of harm that we see against our Mother Earth.

In these past 30 years IEN has now expanded its network to be globally and so we have Indigenous organizations that we work with across the globe and in North America we have a strong positioning on mining operations which is Talia Leeds and geoengineering and carbon pricing which I do but we also do a lot of other work pertaining to just transition and many other things that you can find on our website at IENEarth.org. author: Mag
title: Immer nur Behindertenwerkstätten: Warum verdienen Menschen mit Behinderung so wenig? Und wo bleibt die Inklusion?
content:
Dossier


„

In der Pandemie sind beinahe unbemerkt Löhne in Behindertenwerkstätten gekürzt worden. Schon vorher ließ sich von den Geld kaum leben. (…) Der Lohn der Beschäftigten in Behinderten-Werkstätten setzt sich in Deutschland aus mehreren Teilen zusammen: Ein sogenanntes Arbeitsförderungsgeld von 52 Euro wird aus Töpfen des Landes gezahlt. Dazu kommt ein Grundlohn von 89 Euro und ein individuell festgelegter Steigerungsbetrag. Diese beiden Posten müssen die Werkstätten selbst erwirtschaften. Als die Corona-Pandemie Deutschland erreichte, schlossen die Betreiber ihre Werkstätten für Menschen mit Behinderung. In der Folge konnten viele Aufträge nicht mehr erfüllt werden. Der Steigerungslohn entfiel. (…) 19 Prozent der Werkstätten, die an der Umfrage teil nahmen, gaben an, Löhne gekürzt zu haben. Weitere 18 Prozent gaben an, dass Kürzungen absehbar sind. Insgesamt hat sich in der Umfrage gezeigt, dass die Auswirkungen der Krise verzögert in den Werkstätten ankommen

…“

Artikel von Fabian Hillebrand vom 14.11.2020 im ND online

 

 und auch dazu:


Gerechtigkeit statt Almosen: Die GFF geht mit Jürgen Linnemann gegen das diskriminierende Entgeltsystem in „Werkstätten für behinderte Menschen“ (WfbM) vor Gericht


Mindestlohn in Werkstätten: Der sitzende Leistungsträger


„

Jürgen Linnemann hat 40 Jahre in Werkstätten für Menschen mit Behinderung gearbeitet. Jetzt zieht er für den Mindestlohn vor Gericht. (…) Sie klagen vor dem Arbeitsgericht Münster darauf, dass die Werkstatt ihm die Differenz zwischen seinem bisherigen Arbeitsentgelt und dem Mindestlohn zahlt. Linnemann sei Arbeitnehmer und habe dementsprechend Anrecht auf den Mindestlohn, so die Begründung. Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn müsse zudem auch in Werkstätten gelten. Anfang September soll das Arbeitsgericht eine Entscheidung treffen. Falls es beides verneint, will die GFF das derzeitige Entgeltsystem auf Vereinbarkeit mit Verfassungs-, Unions- und Völkerrecht überprüfen lassen. Bislang fehlen entsprechende Gerichtsentscheidungen. Das könnte sieben bis zehn Jahre dauern, wie Linnemanns Anwältin schätzt. Bis dahin ist er bereits in Rente. (…)


Das Sondersystem der Werkstätten hat der Bundesrepublik bereits zwei Rügen durch den UN-Fachausschuss für die Rechte von Menschen mit Behinderungen beschert. Reformpläne gibt es zahlreiche. Erst 2023 kam eine Studie im Auftrag der damaligen Ampel-Regierung zu dem Ergebnis, dass ein steuersubventioniertes Mindestlohnmodell besser funktionieren und zu mehr Gerechtigkeit führen würde. Andere fordern für einen inklusiven Arbeitsmarkt die Abschaffung der Werkstätten

…“

Artikel von Sarah Yolanda Koss vom 15.10.2026 in ND online

 


Nur 200 Euro Monatslohn. Jürgen Linnemann will per Musterprozess erreichen, dass in Werkstätten für behinderte Menschen Mindestlohn bezahlt wird. Er klagt gegen Lohndumping.


„

Der Mindestlohn von 13,90 Euro pro Stunde gilt fast überall – nicht aber in Werkstätten für behinderte Menschen. Jürgen Linnemann will das ändern. Er arbeitet in den Freckenhorster Werkstätten (NRW). Beim Arbeitsgericht Münster hat er auf Bezahlung von Mindestlohn geklagt. Es ist ein Musterprozess von bundesweiter Bedeutung.


Jürgen Linnemann arbeitet 24,3 Stunden pro Woche und erhält nur einen Stundenlohn von rund 2 Euro. Im Monat macht das knapp 200 Euro. Der 57-Jährige ist Teil eines Teams, das Dokumente digitalisiert. Bevor die Papiere gescannt werden, entfernt Linnemann die Tackerklammern. Für seine Tätigkeit im Werkstattrat – einer Art Betriebsrat – hat er bereits das Bundesverdienstkreuz erhalten.


Jetzt klagt Linnemann für eine bessere Bezahlung. Mit Unterstützung der Gesellschaft für Freiheitsrechte (GFF) und der NGO Sozialhelden hat Linnemann Klage beim Arbeitsgericht Münster erhoben. Er will 1.300 Euro zusätzlich pro Monat, den Mindestlohn eben. Die Klage hat große praktische Relevanz. Bundesweit arbeiten rund 300.000 Personen in rund 700 „Werkstätten für behinderte Menschen“ (WfbM), so der offizielle Titel. Voraussetzung ist, dass man zwar arbeitsfähig ist, aber auf dem normalen Arbeitsmarkt keine Chance hätte. Rund 75 der so Beschäftigten haben eine geistige Behinderung, 20 Prozent haben psychische Beeinträchtigungen, nur 5 Prozent haben eine körperliche Behinderung

title: Gök yarılırken cepheye sürülür gibi: İstanbul’un altında kalanlar
content:
Valilik “zorunlu olmadıkça dışarı çıkmayın” dedi. Fabrikada, tersanede, sokakta, hastanede çalışanlar için o zorunluluğu yine patronlar belirledi.

19 yaşındaki Mazlum Gürbüz, 29 Eylül'de Eyüpsultan Kemerburgaz'daki bir şantiyede yağmur hafifler hafiflemez tabela montajı için sahaya geri çağrıldı. Elindeki metal çıta yüksek gerilim hattına değdi, bir haftalık yaşam mücadelesinin ardından 5 Ekim'de hayatını kaybetti. Çocukluk arkadaşı Levent Çelik, o gün neden işi bırakamadıklarını şöyle anlatmıştı: “İşten çıkarılma korkusuyla mecbur kaldık, çalıştık.”

Aradan iki hafta geçmeden İstanbul ve çevresi çok daha büyük bir sağanakla boğuştu. Valilik okulları tatil etti, kamuda yalnızca belli gruplara idari izin verdi, motokuryeleri trafikten çekti ve halka “zorunlu olmadıkça dışarı çıkmayın” çağrısı yaptı. Özel sektörde çalışan milyonlar için ise tek bir düzenleme çıkmadı.

Kocaeli Başiskele'de Hayat Kimya ve Özka Lastik fabrikalarını su bastı, işçi servisleri tekerlek hizasına kadar suya gömüldü. Arslanbey OSB'de işçiler fabrikaya suların içinden geçerek ulaştı. Ford Otosan'da su basan bölümlerde işçiler sırılsıklam çalıştı. Tuzla ve Yalova tersanelerinde üretim bir an bile aksamadı, vinçlerin yalnızca “kontrollü” kullanılması istendi.

Bunlar ulaşabildiklerimiz. Ulaşamadığımız nice işyerinde de afet koşullarında bile kâr hesabı işçinin canının önüne kondu. Bu koşullarda çalıştırılan her işçi, kapıda bekleyen yeni bir Mazlum Gürbüz demek.

PTT'de taşeron olarak çalışan üç çocuk babası bir dağıtımcı, paketleri sokak sokak yürüyerek dağıtıyor. Çarşamba 165 paketle çıktı, ancak 135'ini teslim edebildi. Dün yine sokaktaydı: “Valilik 'zorunlu olmadıkça çıkmayın' demiş ama bize kimse 'bugün çalışmayın' demedi. Bu sabah da 130 paketle çıktım, bu en az 15 kilometre yol demek. Bizim gibi insanlar için zorunluluk bu.”

Dağıtımcıları yağmurda sokağa iten prim sistemi. 60 paketin üzerine çıkınca prim devreye giriyor: “Üstüne bir 60 daha koyarsam bir yevmiye daha almış gibi oluyorum. Böyle çalışmasam yetiremem. Böyle de yetmiyor gerçi.” Yetmediği için PTT'den sonra Maslak'ta servis şoförlüğü yapıyor, dün eve ancak 23.30'da girebildi: “İnsan işi değil ama başka yolu yok. PTT'den aldığım para ancak çocukların okuluna, beslenmesine gidiyor. Kirayı, faturayı kim ödeyecek?”

Uber Eats'te çalışan bir kurye, sabah birkaç paket teslim edip eve dönmüş ama çalışmayı sürdüren arkadaşlarına kızamıyor: “Hepimiz borçla yaşıyoruz. Ben çalışmadım çünkü bir dayanağım var. Dayanağı olmayan adam mecbur çalışacak, hem de bu havada daha çok çalışacak.” Sokakta kurye azalınca kişi başına düşen paket artıyor, sağanak birçok kurye için bir “fırsata” dönüşüyor. Boynuna kadar suya gömülmüş kurye görüntüsü için şunları söylüyor: “O insanı zincirle sürüsen suya sokamazsın. Ama bizi kendilerine köle ettiler, sıcak evimizden kendi ayağımızla çıkıp suyun içine giriyoruz.”

Motokurye yasağı ise sabit ücreti olmayan kurye için gelirsiz gün demek: “Millet ne yiyecek diye düşünmek yasağı koyanların görevi değil mi? Bunu ücretli izne dönüştürmek çok mu zor? Şirket paketini düşünüyor, devlet gelişigüzel yasak koyuyor, kurye ne yapacak? Beni düşünmediğin yasak önlem değil.”

Bakırköy Belediyesi'nin süpürge işçileri yağmurun bıraktıklarını temizlemek için sahaya sürüldü. Daha önce de haberlerimize konu olan soyunma kulübeleri artık kullanılamaz durumda: “Sivil kıyafetlerimizi koyacak yerimiz bile yok. Dün mesai bitiminde üstümü değiştirmeye girdiğimde kıyafetlerimi su içinde buldum. Herkes evine kaçmanın yolunu ararken kenti temizleyen işçilere reva gördükleri soyunma yeri bu mu?” İşçiler insani dinlenme alanı talebini yılın başında, sözleşme sürecinde dile getirmişti: “Kulak arkası ettiler. Şimdi damı akan, çamur içindeki kulübelerde üstümüzü değiştiriyoruz.”

Park bahçeler ve fen işleri müdürlüğündeki işçi sayısı ise eski başkan Kerimoğlu döneminde 95'ken işten çıkarmalar ve emekliliklerle 35'e düşmüş. Bir işçi anlatıyor: “Dün koca Bakırköy'ün felaketini 5 işçi 24 saat çalışarak toparlamaya çalıştı. 20'nin üzerinde ağaç devrilmiş, onlarca evi, dükkânı su basmış. Hepsine yetişmeye çalışıyoruz.”

Okmeydanı Perpa'da özel bir şirkette çalışan bir emekçi, dün 16.00'da izin alıp çıktı. 40 dakika otobüs bekledi, Sünnet Köprüsü'nde trafik kilitlenince yağmurun altında Alibeyköy metrosuna yürüdü: “Yanımızda kadın, erkek, genç, yaşlı vardı. Hasta bir teyzenin koluna girip oraya kadar getirdik.” Metrodan sonra Gazi'nin girişine kadar yine yürüdü, eve 19.50'de varabildi. Evi uzak iş …

title: Sağlık Bakanlığı: Eşitsizlikleri devam ettirmekte kararlıyız!
content:
Sağlık Bakanlığı İstatistik Yıllığı (SBİY) 2025 Haber Bülteni, 30 Eylül 2025, çarşamba günü, saat 17:00’de 

(!)

 yayımlandı. İlki 12 yıl önce, 2014 yılında yine eylül ayının son günü SBİY 2013 Haber Bülteni olarak yayımlanmıştı. Bülten, istatistik yıllığından yaklaşık üç, dört ay önce daha az sayıdaki veri grubunu kapsayacak şekilde yayımlanıyor. Bununla birlikte, ölümlülük, aşılama ve hizmet kullanımıyla ilgili bir önceki yılın verilerine 9-10 ay sonra da olsa ulaşabilmiş oluyoruz. Ve Türkiye’nin dokuz ilinin bulunduğu coğrafyada yaşayanların, AKP’li yılların bundan önceki 16 yılında olduğu gibi, 17nci yılında da değişmeyen bir biçimde sağlık ve sosyoekonomik eşitsizlere mahkûm edilmiş olduğunu görüyoruz. Bu haftaki yazıda söz konusu durumu ve AKP’li Sağlık Bakanlığı’nın verileri kendine saklamak gibi bir özelliğini kendilerinin sunduğu kaynaklar üzerinden ele alacağım.


ERİŞ BİLALOĞLU YAZDI


Yeni Bir Sıfırlama Çabası mı: Türkiye’de Bebek Ölüm Hızı


29 Ocak 2015


AKP’li bakanlık verileri kendine saklıyor


AKP tarafından 2002 yılında kurulan 58. Hükümet’e kadar sağlık ve sağlık hizmetleriyle ilgili veriler yıllardır istatistik yıllıklarıyla düzenli olarak kamuoyuyla paylaşılıyordu. Ancak

58. Hükümet ve o kabinenin Sağlık Bakanı Recep Akdağ ile birlikte, sağlık ve sağlık hizmetleriyle ilgili veriler kamuoyundan 2011 yılına kadar saklandı,

paylaşılmadı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü başta olmak üzere, Türkiye’nin üyesi olduğu uluslararası kuruluşların talebi üzerine, bir AKP Hükümeti ve Sağlık Bakanı olarak ilk defa 2011 yılında, 2008 yılına ait veriler “Sağlık Bakanlığı Sağlık İstatistikleri Yıllığı 2008” başlığında Bakan Akdağ’ın önsözüyle yayımlandı. O nedenle Türkiye’nin 2003-2007 yıllarına ait sağlık ve sağlık hizmetleriyle ilgili verileri diğer yıllar gibi düzenli bir biçimde bugüne kadar paylaşılmadı.


Sağlık ve sağlık hizmetleriyle ilgili istatistikler, 2011 yılından sonra, Sağlık Bakanlığı ve Türkiye İstatistik Kurumu (TÜİK) tarafından düzenli olarak yayımlanıyor. TÜİK, özelikle doğurganlık ve ölümlülükle ilgili verileri Merkezi Nüfus İdaresi Sistemi (MERNİS) üzerinden iller düzeyinde, sağlık harcamalarıyla ilgili verileri Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı ile Sosyal Güvenlik Kurumu (SGK) ve yerel yönetimlerden ve “Hanehalkı Bütçe Anketi” çalışması üzerinden, hastalıklarla ilgili verileri de “Türkiye Sağlık Araştırması” üzerinden sağlıyor. Sağlık Bakanlığı da bu verileri kullanıp yaptığı hesaplamaları ve sağlık kurumları, sağlık emekçileri, ilaç, sağlık hizmetleri kullanımı vb. verileri Türkiye’nin makro düzeyde ekonomik ve sosyo-ekonomik yapıya göre gruplandığı 12 bölge, İstatistiki Bölge Bilgileri Sınıflaması-1 (İBBS-1), üzerinden paylaşıyor. Bununla birlikte, 

Sağlık Bakanlığı kaynakları üzerinden 81 ilden herhangi birinin sağlık ve sağlık hizmetleri verilerini, durumunu öğrenebilmek mümkün olamıyor.

Çünkü Sağlık Bakanlığı illerin verilerini yayımlamayı uzun zamandır tercih etmiyor.


Tabip Odası Bebek Ölümlerine Önlem Paketini Açıkladı


25 Eylül 2008


Bebek ölüm hızı önemli bir toplumsal sağlık düzeyi göstergesidir


Toplumların sağlık düzeyinin değerlendirilmesi ve izlenebilmesi amacıyla “bebek ölüm hızı”, “beş yaş altı ölüm hızı” ve “doğumda beklenen yaşam süresi” uluslararası alanda sıklıkla kullanılan, kabul görmüş üç değişkendir. Bunlar aynı zamanda, ülkelerin gelişmişlik düzeyi göstergeleri arasında da yer almaktadır. Çünkü, bu üç gösterge bir ülkede, bölgede, ilde vb. öncelikle beslenme, barınma, alt yapı ve eğitim başta olmak üzere, sosyoekonomik koşulların durumu ve sağlık hizmetlerinin ulaşılabilir olup olmamasıyla sağlık hizmetlerinin niteliğinden doğrudan etkilenmektedir.

author: Elizabeth Weill-Greenberg
title: Tablets Make Communication Easier Behind Bars — But Deaf People Are Left Behind
content:
A lawsuit in Illinois charges that prisons blocking videophone capabilities violate the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Tablet computers have revolutionized communication inside prisons for hearing prisoners. Prison systems from across the country — including in New York, California, and Illinois — have distributed tens of thousands of tablets to incarcerated people, which they can use to call home, watch movies, message loved ones, or attend virtual classes (although they are often charged predatory fees for accessing these benefits). As of 2022, 25 state prison systems had tablet distribution programs, according to the Electronic Privacy Information Center.

But as the rollout of such tablets continues, many deaf incarcerated people have been left behind.

Disability justice organization HEARD points out that it’s unknown how many deaf people are incarcerated in U.S. prisons, but a 2015 report by the Bureau of Labor Statistics estimated that 6.2 percent of incarcerated people in state and federal prisons have a hearing disability, which would equal about 71,000 people.

Daniel Valenzuela, who is deaf, is incarcerated at Danville Correctional Center in Illinois. Last year, the Illinois Department of Corrections (IDOC) distributed tablets to all incarcerated people. But IDOC blocks videophone capabilities, preventing Valenzuela from communicating in his primary language, American Sign Language (ASL).

In September, Valenzuela sued the IDOC director for violating the Americans with Disabilities Act.

“I have six kids, four grandkids, and one of my sons is in the military. I cherish and love my family so much,” said Valenzuela in a press release announcing the lawsuit. “I just want to tell them happy birthday and I am so grieved when I can’t call because I don’t want them to think I forgot.”

There are at least three other deaf individuals at Danville who primarily use ASL to communicate, according to the complaint filed by Disability Rights Advocates, Equip for Equality, and the law firm Much Shelist.

“Across the Illinois Department of Corrections, people can use tablets to communicate with their loved ones, which has been a game changer in removing restrictions on communication,” Valenzuela’s attorney, Rachel Weisberg, the directing attorney at Disability Rights Advocates, told Truthout. “But for Mr. Valenzuela and other deaf people who use American Sign Language, that same access simply isn’t available.”

IDOC did not respond to a request for comment by the time of publication.

Last year, in addition to distributing tablets to incarcerated people, IDOC announced it would provide every incarcerated person with 775 free domestic phone call minutes per month. In a press release, IDOC said that these initiatives, working in tandem, “enhance family connections and increase access to technology that supports rehabilitation.”

But deaf prisoners are excluded from accessing these critical programs.

Unlike hearing prisoners who can use their tablets to make calls from their cells, Valenzuela must get a guard’s permission to walk to another building to use the one videophone that’s available to him. In at least one instance, Valenzuela had to go out in the pouring rain to use the videophone, according to the complaint.

“When prison officials don’t communicate with deaf/disabled people in ways they can understand, they may be written up for being ‘non-compliant.'”

The videophone is often unavailable because the unit itself breaks down, the prison is on lockdown, or a guard denies his request, according to the complaint. Last year, Valenzuela was unable to speak with his family during the holidays because the phone was not working for 54 straight days, from November 2025 to January 2026. However, if the tablets malfunction, there are several backup phones that incarcerated hearing people can use, the complaint says.

“We’re asking for equal access, as that’s what the law requires,” said Weisberg. “Equal access is not static — it must reflect the benefits currently offered to others and account for the needs of people with disabilities as technology and communication systems evolve.”

These issues are not limited to Illinois. Advocates say incarcerated deaf people have to contend with discriminatory communication practices in prisons throughout the country.

title: Antiterro et psychiatrie : un bref récap de la loi Rodwell
content:
Quelques infos sur la loi Rodwell, ou loi Philippine, passée fin juillet 2026


La loi Rodwell ou loi Philippine (oui oui, Philippine comme la meuf assassinée par un type sortant de

CRA

 en septembre 2024, provoquant une campagne de haine raciste et xénophobe), ou loi du 27 juillet 2026, est une loi qui mixe le droit pénal, le droit de la santé et le droit des étrangers pour «

 

prévenir le passage à l'acte terroriste

 

» - ambiance minority report.


Pour résumer, c'est un renforcement ou une adaptation de mesures répressives qui étaient déjà souvent présentes - et mises en place - dans le droit français : il y a peu de choses complètement nouvelles. On trouve intéressant d'analyser ici quelques unes de ses principales mesures, notamment du fait des liens étroits entre répression et psychiatrie, qui sont très explicites dans la loi.


La loi met en place :


1) Une rétention de sûreté terroriste à l'issue de la peine : enfermement d'une personne dans des établissements «

 

socio-médico-judiciaires de sûreté

 

» après l'exécution complète de sa peine. Cette mesure concernerait les personnes condamnées à une peine d'au moins quinze ans pour un crime de terrorisme. Une commission, peu avant la fin de la peine, doit déterminer si la personne présente une «

 

particulière dangerosité

 

», concept carrément flou évalué notamment sur des critères encore plus flous comme le «

 

risque de récidive

 

», «

 

l'adhésion persistante à une idéologie terroriste

 

» et un «

 

trouble grave de la personnalité

 

»...


Comme pour la plupart des mesures d'enfermement dans des établissements assimilables à des

HP

, il n'y a pas de durée maximale prévue par la loi - en général c'est un an, reconductible à peu près indéfiniment (le principe c'est que la personne y reste jusqu'à ce qu'elle ne représente plus un danger pour la société...)


Il est intéressant de noter que des mesures similaires existaient déjà depuis 2008 pour certains crimes de «

 

droit commun

 

» : meurtre, viol, torture, actes de barbarie, séquestration et enlèvement. Ça concernerait très peu de personnes actuellement, mais on se doute que cette loi va permettre de renflouer les dispositifs existants.


2) Une injonction préfectorale d'examen psychiatrique : de ce qu'on comprend, à n'importe quel moment (pas besoin d'être en gav ou en examen, ou même d'avoir «

 

troublé l'ordre public

 

»), le préfet peut obliger une personne à subir un examen psychiatrique approfondi - par un psychiatre figurant sur une liste établie par la cour d'appel. C'est vraiment sur la base de suspicion de «

 

radicalisation

 

» et de «

 

troubles mentaux

 

». Et bon quand on sait que les fichiers d'Hopsyweb sur les personnes hospitalisées sous contraintes sont croisés avec ceux des «

 

fichiers de traitement des signalements pour la prévention de la radicalisation à caractère terroriste

 

», cela fait déjà une bonne liste de potentiels suspects. Si le certificat médical émis par le psychiatre va dans ce sens, le préfet peut décider d'interner la personne en

HP

 sans son consentement (mais ça, ça existait déjà bien avant). Autant préciser que cette visite au toubib n'est pas facultative : on a la possibilité de faire appel au juge administratif en théorie, mais si on refuse de voir le psychiatre ou si on ne s'y présente pas dans le délai imparti, c'est perquiz, pour se rendre au rendez-vous sous escorte.


3) Une mesure judiciaire de rétention pour les condamnés de droit commun «

 

radicalisés

 

» - là, la loi viserait spécifiquement les gens qui seraient passés par la taule (au moins 10 ans) pour des faits non-liés au terrorisme, mais se seraient «

 

radicalisés

 

» en prison. Là encore, en fin de peine, une commission évalue si le détenu présente une «

 

dangerosité particulière

 

». Si oui, et contrairement à la rétention de sûreté terroriste, la personne n'est pas ré-enfermée, mais elle a droit à l'équivalent d'un suivi

SPIP

réintégration

 

» : ce suivi peut inclure une obligation de taff ou de formation, un suivi psychiatrique, l'obligation d'habiter dans une zone déterminée... En gros, un contrôle très approfondi de la vie de la personne dans ses moindres aspects.

title: Join our next PeerNetz session: building peer-led trans healthcare
content:
As part of our Peer Networking Zone (PeerNetz), TGEU is hosting a meeting to explore healthcare designed by and for trans people, rooted in community knowledge and care. We’ll be joined by Trans Healthcare Action, the organisation behind Kindred, Ireland’s first peer-led trans health clinic.


The session will be interactive, with practical exercises and space to explore how Kindred’s experience and lessons could translate to different contexts across Europe and Central Asia.


About the session


Date & time:


15 October, 16:00 – 17:30 CEST

Location:

 Online via Zoom

Cost:

 Free

Target audience:

 Trans communities and activists 


Register here


What the session will cover 


Trans Healthcare Actions will share how Kindred was created through co-creation between the local trans community and allied healthcare professionals, and walk us through the clinic’s foundation, model, structure, services and vision.


The session will also explore how the Irish social, legal and medical landscape shaped their approach, and invite participants to think about their own contexts: What gaps exist in trans healthcare? What community networks and resources are already available? What might help or hinder efforts to build similar community-led care?

We work across Europe and Central Asia to advance trans rights, build strong communities, and drive change through research, advocacy, and community-building.


Your donation helps us continue this vital work — defending trans lives, amplifying trans voices, and advocating for justice every day.

title: Le temps des promesses
content:
Alors que la jeunesse française embrase le pays, nous avons interviewé Christian Ingrao pour son nouveau livre

Le Temps des promesses

. La situation présente est le produit d'une lente glaciation de l'espérance qui avait été annoncée non par des prophètes, mais par des historiens, des économistes, des ingénieurs agronomes, et toutes ces littératures grises qui enregistrent, en même temps qu'elles font, l'espérance et ses vacillements. Nous vivons les derniers moments d'une série de promesses nées aux lendemains de la mutation anthropologique des guerres mondiales, et dont la force d'élan et d'entraînement s'est tarie au tournant des années 1980. En réactivant une méthode matérialiste inspirée de Engels et Marx, Ingrao parvient à reconstruire la « sociogenèse de l'espérance », depuis une multitude d'observatoires, dont le temps présent nous dit la fin.

author: Enrico Gnaulati, PhD
title: The Hidden Psychotherapy Drop-Out Crisis
content:
T

here is a psychotherapy drop-out crisis that the general public is largely unaware of and the mental health field apparently overlooks.

Conservative estimates

 of the

number of people who discontinue psychotherapy

 after starting hover around 28-33 percent, with well upwards of half doing so within the first few sessions.

Trustworthy sources

 reveal that the

median number of sessions

 received by people entering psychotherapy falls somewhere between seven and nine.


I call these estimates conservative because the way psychotherapy drop-out is typically defined and measured reflects medicalized models of short-term interventions aimed primarily at symptom reduction.

Evidence-based treatment protocols

 considered adequate for improvement typically last 12-16 sessions, with

a range of roughly 6 to 20 sessions

 depending on the type of disorder and its severity.


Admittedly, there are those people for whom a brief course of therapy aimed at symptom reduction is both preferred and satisfactory. However, it appears that such individuals are in the minority.

A recent survey sponsored by the Psychotherapy Action Network (PsiAN)

 of more than 1500 adults in the U.S. found that 88 percent “Prefer therapy that may take longer because it helps you manage your symptoms and also addresses the root cause of problems.” Moreover, a substantial number of clients who receive short-term evidence-based treatments do not walk away recovered.

One set of meta-analyses of depression treatments

 observed that more than half of clients studied failed to respond (experience at least a 50 percent reduction in symptoms) and only one third were in remission upon completion, or experienced symptoms at subclinical levels.


Image created by AI tool


All this begs the question: How much psychotherapy does the typical person need  presenting with some combination of anxiety, depression, difficult personality traits, and life distress, to obtain meaningful and lasting change?


Recent robust meta-analytic findings deliver an answer. A

study out of University College London

 assessing the results of sixteen randomized trials of long-term intensive psychotherapy substantiated that obtaining a course of treatment greater than or equal to 9 months, or 30 sessions, is associated with significant and sustained alleviation of depression, compared to active, less intensive treatments. Another

research team out of Amsterdam found

 that obtaining 50 psychotherapy sessions a year (beginning twice weekly) produced faster and greater amelioration of depression and difficult personality traits than approximately 25 sessions.


Consequently, if we land on 30-50 sessions of psychotherapy as a ballpark reasonable  number of sessions for the typical anxious and depressed client facing interpersonal challenges to obtain meaningful and sustained change, it falls woefully short of the median 7-9 sessions most people typically receive when they pursue psychotherapy.


What accounts for this underutilization? Obviously, there are the material and logistical reasons that people cite for discontinuing: cost/financial hardship, inadequate insurance coverage, transportation issues, scheduling conflicts. Nonetheless, in my estimation a pivotal overlooked reason is the discrepancy between what most people embarking on psychotherapy seek from the experience and what legions of practitioners are trained to provide.


The PsiAN survey cited above underscored how 73 percent of participants agreed that “The most valuable aspect of therapy is sharing your thoughts and feelings without feeling judged or ashamed”; and 67 percent of those asked why people sought therapy endorsed the statement:

“

To better understand yourself and the root of your issues.” Extrapolating from these results, it would seem that most people cultivate preferences for age-old notions of psychotherapy that have proven remarkable durable: A culturally sanctioned space to candidly share whatever is on your mind for as long is needed to obtain fundamental salutary shifts in how you feel about yourself and your life.


Yet, current professional training diverges from this ethos, underscoring evidence-based treatments, or short-term, protocol-driven approaches to psychotherapy focused on symptom reduction. The

National Psychotherapy Training Survey

, conducted over the past few decades

points to greater numbers

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

I den ungsocialistiska pressen hade så tidigt som år 1907 agitation förts för syndikalismen. I majnumret år 1910 av den fackliga tidningen Bageriarbetaren gjorde bagarnas förtroendeman, Anders Sjöstedt, som var redaktör för nämnda tidning, ett försök att hindra syndikalismens spridning bland bagarna, vilka i stort antal gripits av den syndikalistiska agitationen. Då skrev undertecknad ett genmäle mot den mäktiga förbundschefens angrepp under rubriken: **.."Man säger... Genmäle på artikeln i majnumret."*

"Man säger, att bagarna skola vara med då det gäller att upplösa förbunden och bilda Lokala Samorganisationer", inledde vår förtroendeman Anders Sjöstedt, och tillade sedan: "Tack för erbjudandet, men skall man då behandla bagarna på samma sätt som man vill göra nu, tycker vi synd om bagarna." På detta sätt vill jag svara att aggressiva kommer arbetsgivarna alltid att vara oavsett vilken organisationsform arbetarna har, tills dess de får så kraftigt mothugg så de lugnar sina rovdjurskänslor. Och då behövs det sannerligen syndikalistiskt försvarskraft. Därför kan inte en förtroendeman, om än med stor vilja, uträtta något ensamt - utan en vaken, handlingsfull och slagkraftig organisation.

Lusten att krossa arbetarnas organisationer har icke saknats av de privata arbetsgivarna - ej ens från styrelser och föreståndare för kooperativa bagerier i södra Sverge. Närmare angivet Skåne. Där har till och med öppna strider utbrutit.

Alla arbetsgivare vill ha utgifterna så små som möjligt. Men inkomsterna så stora som möjligt. Detta får ju främst arbetarna, producenterna, lida för.

Vidare hade Sjöstedt skrivit: "Lyssna på styrelserna för 'Föreningsbagerierna' och och för en del kooperativa bagerier vilka diskutera om bagarna på ett utmanande sätt, när det gäller deras avtal."

För min del tyckte jag att bagarna icke skulle bry sig om vad dessa konservativa styrelsemedlemmar pladdrar om. Och är det någon underhandling de ej vill bry sig om och önskar de icke vara med om någon överenskommelse som vi vet att de kan gå med på, behöver vi icke kompromissa och springa och berusa dessa herrar i all evighet, och tigga om rätt till mänsklig existens. Vi ha förmåga att slå till! Vi äro de starka! Gör slut på fegheten! Det är vi som är producenter!

Därför behöva att omändra organisationerna till kampduglighet och smidig anpassningsförmåga efter de förhållanden som kan uppstå. Vad de Lokala Samorganisationerna angår så äro de mest praktiska, och kan med heder avlösa de gamla tungrodda byråkratiska fackföreningarna, som äro i majoritet i detta land.

Att inte organisationsfrågan är ett aktuellt spörsmål just nu, bland bagarna, är en lögn av stort mått. Den är aktuell och skall bliva det ännu mer när tiden är mogen. Trots vad Sjöstedt skriver! Och hans ångest som så tydligt märks!

Allt sedan de reformistiska organisationernas början har i regel "förts de korslagda armarnas strid", som de gamla ledana är så förtjusta i - till borgardömets fromma!

Detta har visat sig odugligt. Vi har ju bagerier, som är bojkottade ända sedan den tid som "Svenska Bageri- och Konditoriarbetareförbundet" startades. Och det var inte i går!

Vi har exempel på detta i Göteborg och i Uddevalla, ja lite varstans i detta land.

Det skulle taga allt för stort utrymme i anspråk att räkna upp alla. Och när uppgörelse kommer att träffas vet ingen! Och ingen gör något för att ändring skall ske. Ingen delar ut så mycket som en bojkottslapp för att upplysa allmänheten om förhållandet, att konflikt råder. Därför behövs det pigga organisationer i vilka medlemmarna äro socialistiskt skolade och nyktra. Då kan vi marschera framåt och vinna något, trots det att arbetsgivarna göra allt för att slå ned vår frammarsch. Detta få ingen glömma!

Man skriver så ofta och påstår att folk är så egoistiska, att de ej vill betala avgifterna till föreningarna …
